shell_commands: ls src src/transport src/transport/ws src/types 2>/dev/null && cat package.json | head -60
grep -rn "createHalEngine" src/*.test.ts example/*.ts | head -10; grep -n "MockConfig" -A 8 src/providers/mock/index.ts | head -20
cat tsconfig.json && sed -n '60,110p' src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts && sed -n '180,240p' src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts
ls scripts/ | head -40; ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "spec-anchor\|specs/hal-engine" src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts | head -5
grep -rn "validated by\|spec:" scripts/check-spec-links.mjs | head -20 && sed -n '1,60p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs
grep -rln "captureErrors" src scripts | head; grep -rn "captureErrors()" -A 3 src/transport/abandonOnClose.test.ts | head -12
grep -n "answers a list it cannot serve" src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts

git add src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git status --short && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(transport): acceptance tests for the conversation list frame

re-cinq/HALEngine#144: a client asks the socket it is already
authenticated on which conversations it has. Five red acceptance
tests over real engines and real sockets - the validator's frame
rules, the connecting user's own list (authorisation from the
connection, never the frame), limit/before reaching listFor, the
UNSUPPORTED/SERVER_ERROR refusals with the socket kept open, and the
answer arriving off the per-session turn lock.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1 | tail -5
